title: 10 years of coding, this was the first time I leaned heavily on AI to take an idea to reality.
author: Grox_are_shitty
selftext:
Hey! So after some reluctance, I decided to create a workflow with a mix of astra, sol, meshy, and suno. For a simple roguelike idea. Basically you have a pirate ship and sail the seas hunting other ships, stealing, scavenging, and trying to upgrade your ship through a semi RNG system. I am quite happy with the results so far after about a week of work.

I could use some help testing, and would love to know what others think of it, what I should add, and if the gameplay loop is actually fun.

Its a web based game that I am hosting for free on itch. I call it "Boat! A Pirate Roguelike"

https://nateharmsfpv.itch.io/boat

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/ylkrw9lt7eth1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=a79432502a732ef065ebd65eaaa50acd315e44f7

Quite fun! The waves creating some shot verticality, the wind/angle/timing etc - it's all rather nicely tuned to make a very simple control that's easy to pick up and satisfying to pull off. I was getting chased by a trio of big bois and sunk two on little turns/pivots while dodging incoming broadsides (having that warning is a good mechanic). Very cool :)

replies.author: Grox_are_shitty
replies.body: Thanks for giving it a try! I'm glad you found it enjoyable and easy to pick up. Is there anything you would like to see changed?

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: I think the core is v solid already to build out of, just needs a bit of pacing work maybe and some UI love. Just my humble 2c :)

replies.author: Grox_are_shitty
replies.body: I appreciate that! I will work on those items

comments.author: NikopikVR
comments.body: "Yeah another roguelike" said nobody ever in 2026 because we're flooded by thousands of roguelike

replies.author: Glass_Quantity_3493
replies.body: That's like saying "yeah another action game" because we're not flooded by action games since 1990. It's just a genre dude.

comments.author: qing-turn
comments.body: Same here, years of coding but the first time letting AI carry most of it, and about a week to a playable loop matches my experience too. The semi-RNG upgrades sound like where the replay value lives. Do players see their options before they commit, or is it pure luck?

comments.author: DownloadPlayShare
comments.body: I know it's intended for desktop but I tried it on mobile. It looks great, text a bit small but it runs well, just no controls available to steer and fire. Would be fun to play here. Request from my son "icebergs!" He's obsessed over the titanic :D

comments.author: thygrrr
comments.body:
I also have an endless pirate passion project thing going on.

In this one, I like the general look and feel of the battles (even if the wind and sail simulation aren't there yet).

My favourite feature, and it's so fucking simple I am angry I never though about it, is that pressing LMB fires the Port and the RMB fires the Starboard broadside. GENIUS!

comments.author: jamiejimbosmith
comments.body: Looks great. Kind of reminds me of the PlayStation game ‘Overboard!’
